instance_description:
Setting: During 2026, this instance covers a municipal adult-school court-interpreting certificate with evening classes, online modules, language-lab practice, and supervised courthouse observation.
Scope: Recurring areas include lesson planning, bilingual terminology study, mock interpreting drills, observation hours, tutoring, assessments, credential paperwork, instructor communication, and education expenses.
Resources: Reusable records track learner items, scheduled learning events, and certificate requirements; blank files support practice notes, glossary drafting, and message preparation; a personal wallet handles authorized costs.
Exclusions: It excludes paid interpreting work, legal advice, official court systems, instructor grading authority, classmates’ private information, unauthorized recording, and language practice outside the certificate context.
personal_description:
Identity: Amara Selwyn Reyes is an adult learner enrolled throughout 2026 in a Spanish-English court-interpreting certificate at a city adult-education center.
Responsibilities: She organizes weekly coursework, terminology review, interpreting drills, observation documentation, tutoring follow-up, assessment preparation, attendance evidence, and credential-readiness materials.
Authority: Amara may manage her study records, draft her own submissions, schedule permitted student services, contact instructors, and make personal education purchases.
Restrictions: She cannot certify herself, alter official attendance or scores, access restricted court records, advise litigants, record proceedings without permission, or commit classmates to shared work.
